title: (RHBA-2019:2999) Update RH-SSO TP CD 7 OpenShift Image to address nghttp2 CVEs
portal_summary:
Updates are now available for the Red Hat Single Sign-On Continuous Delivery
Technology Preview CD 7 image, running on OpenShift Container Platform 3.10
and 3.11.

The Red Hat Single Sign-On Continuous Delivery (RH-SSO CD) releases
are Technology Previews, intended for development use only. DO NOT
deploy these versions on production or environments that are not
intended for development use.
portal_synopsis: Update RH-SSO TP CD 7 OpenShift Image to address nghttp2 CVEs
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.1|x86_64
portal_solution:
To update to the latest Red Hat Single Sign-On Technology Preview
OpenShift image, follow these steps to pull in the content:

1. Ensure you are logged into the CLI on your master hosts as a
cluster administrator or user with project administrator access
to the global "openshift" project. For example:

$ oc login -u system:admin

2. Run the following command to update the Red Hat Single Sign-On Technology
Preview CD 7 OpenShift image in the "openshift" project:

$ oc -n openshift import-image redhat-sso-cd-openshift-rhel8:7.0
portal_description:
Red Hat Single Sign-On is an integrated sign-on solution, available as a
Red Hat JBoss Middleware for OpenShift containerized image. The Red Hat
Single Sign-On for OpenShift image provides an authentication server for
users to centrally log in, log out, register, and manage user accounts
for web applications, mobile applications, and RESTful web services.

The Red Hat Single Sign-On Technology Preview CD 7 image, for use within
the OpenShift Container Platform 3.10 and within the OpenShift
Container Platform 3.11 cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS)
for on-premise or private cloud deployments, has been updated to
address the following security advisories: RHSA-2019:2692.

Users of sso-cd-tech-preview/sso-cd-openshift-rhel8 container images
are advised to upgrade to this updated image, which contains backported
patches to correct these security issues. You should rebuild all container
images that depend on this image.

You can find the image updated by this advisory in Red Hat Container
Catalog.
